title: Nea Ɔkura Nkrasɛm a Ɛyɛ Damoa
intro: Wɔsomaa ɔkra trenee bi sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛ nkurɔfo a wɔayera wɔ mmarato a ebi mmae da mu kwan. Saa ɔbɔfo yi gyinaa pintinn, na ɔde kɔkɔbɔ a emu yɛ den mae wɔ adifudepɛ bi a ɛne abɔde mu nhyehyɛe nhyia ho. Ɛmfa ho sɛ wɔsrɛɛ wɔn anibere so no, mpɔtam hɔfo no de wɔn ho hyɛɛ sum mu kɛse, na ɛmaa ɔsoro akontaabu a ɛnte sɛ afoforo biara ho kwan. So wubetumi ahu Allah akoa a ogyina pintinn yi?
clues: Ná meyɛ odiyifo kɛse foforo busuani, na me ne no tu kɔɔ baabi foforo, na migyaw yɛn kurom hɔ.
Wɔsomaa me kɔɔ nkurɔfoɔ bi a wɔn amumuyɛ yɛ soronko, mmarato a na abɔdeɛ biara nyɛɛ wɔ wɔn anim.
M’ankasa me fie mu paapaee; abusua muni bi a ɔbɛn wɔn paa gyinaa atiafo no afã wɔ kokoam.
Abɔfo a wɔyɛ mmerante a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ baa me fie sɛ ahɔho, na wɔde ahoyeraw kɛse baa me so maa wɔn ahobammɔ.
Mede m’ankasa me mmabea mae sɛ wɔnware me nkurɔfo de bɔɔ mmɔden denneennen sɛ mɛdan wɔn afi wɔn aniwu nneyɛe no ho.
Wɔnam nteɛm a ɛyɛ hu ne abo a wɔde dɔte a wɔato tɔe so sɛee me nkurɔfo, bere a me ne m’abusua, gye biako pɛ, nyaa nkwa denam kɔ ​​a yefii hɔ anadwo a ɛyɛ hu no so.

trial.label: Dɛn ne Me Sɔhwɛ Titiriw?
options: Ɔhene otirimɔdenfo bi a mɛgye adi sɛ ɔnnhyew me wɔ ogya mu.
Me nuanom ahoɔyaw ne wɔn a wɔtow wɔn guu abura mu no ho dwuma.
Nkurɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe a ebi mmae da mu a wobehyia.
Me nkurɔfo a wodi wɔn anim fi nkoasom mu fi farao a ɔwɔ tumi mu.
Hyɛn kɛse bi a wɔreyɛ de agye agyidifo no afi nsuyiri kɛse bi mu.
trial.answer: Nkurɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe a ebi mmae da mu a wobehyia.

location.label: Beae Bɛn na Na M’Asɛmpatrɛw no Wɔ?
options: Madyan kurow no mu
Tete kurow Iram
Misraim asase a na Farao di n’ase
Sodom ne Gomora nkuro
Niniwe kurow no

outcome.label: Dɛn ne Nea Efii Mu Bae Awiei?
options: Wɔdanee nkurow no na wɔde dɔte a wɔatow abo guu so.
Asase menee me nkurɔfoɔ kaa wɔn kannifoɔ a ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ no ho.
Mframa a ano yɛ den sɛee me nkurɔfo anadwo nson ne nnawɔtwe.
Na ɔhaw ahorow te sɛ mmoadabi, nwansena ne mponkyerɛn huu me nkurɔfo.
Mpataa kɛse bi menee me bere a migyaee m’asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no akyi.
outcome.answer: Wɔdanee nkurow no na wɔde dɔte a wɔatow abo guu so.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
verse: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were] (11:82)
